issues.jp_before: 友達[ともだち]からおいしいお菓子[かし]を{もらいました|gv-morau}。
issues.problem: All three distractors were tense/mood variants of もらう with no time word in the sentence; もらいます is only excluded by the English and the item drilled tense rather than direction of giving.
issues.action: Distractors changed to あげました, さしあげました, もらいます.

issues.jp_before: 父[ちち]は会社[かいしゃ]の人[ひと]に旅行[りょこう]のお土産[みやげ]を{もらいました|gv-morau}。
issues.problem: English 'a souvenir from a trip from someone' was clumsy.
issues.action: English changed to 'My father got a travel souvenir from someone at his company.'

issues.jp_before: 私[わたし]は毎年[まいとし]、会社[かいしゃ]からカレンダーを{もらいます|gv-morau}。
issues.problem: Distractor もらいました is grammatical with 毎年 (past habitual 'I used to get one every year'), so it is defensible.
issues.action: Distractors changed to あげます, くれます, さしあげます.

issues.jp_before: 娘[むすめ]は誕生日[たんじょうび]に祖父[そふ]に腕時計[うでどけい]を{もらいました|gv-morau}。
issues.problem: 祖父 is the speaker's own grandfather (the daughter's great-grandfather), contradicting 'her grandfather'; the double に was also awkward.
issues.action: Rewritten as 娘[むすめ]は誕生日[たんじょうび]に、おじいちゃんから腕時計[うでどけい]を{もらいました|gv-morau}。

issues.jp_before: 山田[やまだ]さんは姉[あね]に服[ふく]を{もらったそうです|gv-morau}。
issues.problem: Humble 姉 refers to the speaker's own sister, not 'her older sister'.
issues.action: Changed 姉[あね] to お姉[ねえ]さん.

issues.jp_before: 学校[がっこう]で先生[せんせい]に新[あたら]しいノートを{もらいました|gv-morau}。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the 先生に本を and 先輩にノートを items.
issues.action: Rewritten as 学校[がっこう]で先生[せんせい]に宿題[しゅくだい]のプリントを{もらいました|gv-morau}。 / 'At school I got a homework handout from the teacher.'
